title: Smoky Slow Cooker Bean Chili
description: A hearty, mild bean chili that cooks itself in the slow cooker. Replace with your own description.
author: Your Name

sections.p: Write your own explanation of the method here. Keep it to a short paragraph, then give exact low and high heat times.
For each key ingredient, give a bold name and one sentence about the choice or a substitution.
Summarize the process in four short verbs (Brown, Transfer, Combine, Cook). The full method lives in the recipe card below.

ingredients.t: fine sea salt, or to taste

steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high. Brown the meat 4 to 5 minutes, breaking it up, then add the onion and cook until tender.
Stir in the garlic and spices for 30 seconds. Transfer everything to a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the drained beans, tomatoes and tomato sauce. Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or high 3 to 4 hours. Taste and adjust the salt before serving.
notes: Canned goods vary in salt, so season at the end. For a thicker chili, cook uncovered for the last 15 minutes.
